title: RAVITEJA – Mouli Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for RAVITEJA – Mouli — premieres Nov 13, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for RAVITEJA – Mouli dropped November 10, 2026.
  • New Telugu movie premiering Nov 13, 2026 on Mythri Movie Makers.
  • Mass Maharaja RAVITEJA Launches DNK TRAILER Video on @MythriMovieMakers

The makers of RAVITEJA – Mouli have released the official trailer, unveiled November 10, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
